title: Peg-stability obligations can be rented between Agents, but only as an indivisible bundle
content:
A.3.3.1.6 opens a market in the ALM obligation itself: Prime Agents "may enter into Asset Liability Management Rentals between each other," so that "one Prime Agent to hold a greater amount of Actively Stabilizing Collateral to offset another Prime Agent holding a lesser amount. Thus, the overall level of Actively Stabilizing Collateral is unaffected but the Actively Stabilizing Collateral can be held by a Prime Agent that is able to more efficiently hold it."

This restores at the market level what the per-Agent ratio gave up. Agents differ in how cheaply they can hold peg reserves — one running a stablecoin market-making strategy holds qualifying assets as a by-product, while one deployed in RWAs must break a position to comply. Trading the obligation lets it settle with whoever bears it most cheaply, without the ecosystem total moving.

A.3.3.1.6.1 supplies the anti-cherry-picking rule: "When Asset Liability Management obligations are rented, the associated obligations with regard to Actively Stabilizing Collateral, Demand Absorption Buffer, and Peg Defense Events are all transferred together."

That bundling is essential. The three obligations have very different cost profiles — holding ASC is a steady, compensated carrying cost, while the Peg Defense obligation is a rare, uncompensated, potentially very large call on capital during exactly the worst conditions. Allowed to unbundle, the market would price and trade the cheap continuous obligation and leave the expensive contingent one stranded with whoever was least able to shed it. Selling the reserve requires selling the duty to deploy it.

The arrangement's residual risk is concentration: an efficient market naturally consolidates ALM obligations into a few Agents, so the ecosystem's peg defense could end up depending on the operational readiness of one or two counterparties during an event. The Atlas does not cap how much ALM obligation a single Agent may take on.
description: ALM Rentals let one Agent hold more ASC so another can hold less without changing the ecosystem total; when rented, the ASC, DAB and Peg Defense obligations all transfer together.
